items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject all new change requests this cycle. Financial claims are unsupported: Amazon reports $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but all $4.92 is in aggregate tracking ID "other" and cannot be assigned to a site; attributed income is $0. The export has 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items, but this does not establish site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, or forecast. AI usage cost is $916.914544 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 5,009 calls, while matching-period infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, commitment, and other operating costs are unavailable. Budget ceiling, monthly spend limit, commitments, and approved cost-to-learn threshold are blank, so budget exposure, contribution margin, and cost-to-learn remain unknown rather than zero. SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating indicators only; 36 improvements await measurement and only 3 outcomes are proven as of 2026-09-28. Continue only the existing CFO reconciliation work item and existing measurement/repair evidence; do not create duplicate finance work, spend, telemetry, deployments, requeues, or monetization changes. Minimum finance artifact remains a dated matching-period ledger containing provider/site/content revenue identifiers, AI cost, infrastructure cost, other operating cost, commitments, budget ceiling, and an approved learning threshold.
